conditions: Apply the higher-order monotone VI upper bound on a known ball of radius $2R$ whose center is within $R$ of a root. Strong monotonicity bounds distance by the tangent residual divided by $\mu$. Halve $R$ at each stage. The stage cost is $O_p(1+(L_pR^{p-1}/\mu)^{2/(3p-1)})$; summing the geometric series gives the stated bound.

proofs.title: Strong-monotonicity restart of the higher-order tangential-residual algorithm
proofs.body: Apply the higher-order monotone VI upper bound on a known ball of radius $2R$ whose center is within $R$ of a root. Strong monotonicity bounds distance by the tangent residual divided by $\mu$. Halve $R$ at each stage. The stage cost is $O_p(1+(L_pR^{p-1}/\mu)^{2/(3p-1)})$; summing the geometric series gives the stated bound.
proofs.scope: All model, oracle, algorithm, guarantee, quantity, resource-projection, and region conditions attached to the mapped bounds remain in force.

proofs.title: Return the known root z0.
proofs.body: If $R_0=0$, the initialization promise forces $z_0=z^\star$. Return $z_0$ without querying. Both distance and the true root residual are zero, and no smaller query cost is possible.
